cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import subprocess, json
SUB=["python3","/workspace/submission/main.py"]
base = json.load(open('/workspace/examples/input.json'))
exp = json.load(open('/workspace/examples/expected.json'))
s = json.dumps(base, separators=(",",":"))
MAX = 16*1024*1024
n = MAX - len(s) - 1
doc_exact = s + "\n" + " "*n
assert len(doc_exact.encode()) == MAX, len(doc_exact.encode())
for name, txt in [("exact 16MiB (trailing ws)", doc_exact),
                  ("16MiB+1", doc_exact + " "),
                  ("leading ws", "  \n\t" + s + "\n"),
                  ("no trailing newline", s)]:
    p = subprocess.run(SUB, input=txt.encode(), capture_output=True)
    try:
        ok = json.loads(p.stdout) == exp
    except Exception:
        ok = "unparsable:" + p.stdout[:60].decode()
    print("%-26s rc=%d bytes=%d accepted=%s" % (name, p.returncode, len(txt.encode()), ok))
PYEOF
